title: AgentActionLog
description: One record per agent action. This is the minimum instrument for Tier 4 (engineering-process) evaluation: none of the Class A process metrics are computable without it. Independent of benchmarks/AGENT_RUN_IDENTITY.schema.json — identity says which run this is, the action log says what happened inside it; neither references the other so they version independently. Instrument definition only: registers no suite, authorizes no execution, asserts no result.

seq.description: Monotonic index within the run. Ordering is the metric substrate; wall-clock timestamps are not required to be monotonic under concurrency.

action_class.description: Declared by the emitting harness, which is where the knowledge lives. A harness that mis-declares can inflate verification_attempted — that is the metric's principal false-positive mode and it is not detectable from the log alone.

args_sha256.description: Digest over NORMALIZED arguments (repo-relative paths, sorted keys). Repeat detection compares this, never raw argument dicts.

args.description: Optional human-readable pre-image of args_sha256. Not used by any metric.

targets.description: Repo-relative paths this action read or mutated. Required in practice for premature_edit_rate and scope_violation_rate; empty for actions that touch no file.

result_sha256.description: Digest of the result payload. repeated_action_rate requires it: an action repeated after a CHANGED result is retrying against new information, which is not the failure being measured.

post_state_sha256.description: For mutating actions: digest of the target's content after the mutation. Reversion detection compares against earlier states of the same target.

claimed_complete.description: The agent asserted the task was done at this action. Consumed by the Class B claimed-complete-but-failing metric, which additionally needs gold tests and is therefore not in benchmarks/process_metrics.py.

confidence.description: RESERVED FOR CLASS D — no consumer today. Present because a probability emitted before the outcome is known cannot be back-filled into an already-collected log; calibration metrics (ECE/Brier) are deliberately not built until a consumer exists.

agent_run_id.description: Optional back-reference to an AgentRunIdentity record. Not required: the log is a valid instrument on its own, and coupling the two schemas would force a version bump on both when either moves.

actions.description: Ordered by seq. May be empty — an agent that took no action is a real and distinct outcome from one whose log was not captured.

declared_scope.description: Repo-relative path prefixes the run was permitted to mutate. Required for scope_violation_rate; absent means the metric is undefined, not zero.
